I'm Associate Director, Biostatistics at Pfizer in Chennai, on the Data Science &
Analytics India leadership team, where I lead a team of statisticians across
global Inflammation & Immunology development programs.

My current work sits in I&I, but oncology is where I built my regulatory
foundation. Before Pfizer I was a primary statistical reviewer at the FDA's
Oncology Center of Excellence, assessing NDA and BLA submissions across gastric
and gastroesophageal cancers, cholangiocarcinoma and other solid tumors, and
leading sponsor–agency interactions and labelling negotiations. At Pfizer I served
as trial statistician on targeted-therapy programs in non-small cell lung cancer
and melanoma.

What holds my attention now are the methods that change what a development
program can learn — real-world evidence and target trial emulation, external
control cohorts, endpoint consolidation, real-time trial monitoring. I worked on
one of the FDA's early evaluations of non-traditional evidence through the review
of a pediatric neuroblastoma program, and I'm building that capability at Pfizer
now.

Earlier: a PhD in Statistics from the University of Florida, and two years
teaching as a tenure-track assistant professor.

[Views on this site are my own and do not represent my employer.]{.disclaimer}
